description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
